entries.description: Use when you are participating in, coordinating or facilitating a task that needs a single outcome that satisfies multiple agents with different, potentially conflicting criteria — a unilateral choice is not enough. Activate on confirmed conflict (agents returned divergent outputs), anticipated conflict (distinct roles on a shared decision make divergence structurally likely), or when you cannot tell whether roles will diverge — uncertainty is itself the signal. Also activate when you would relay outputs from other agents to a downstream agent whose criteria bear on the decision: include that agent directly instead of forwarding a pre-digested summary. Apparent agreement upstream is not a reason to skip — a downstream relay recipient may still hold different criteria. Also activate when an upstream protocol (e.g. ACCORD) has handed you a pre-verified conflict frame. Do NOT activate when a single role owns the decision or agents work on separate sub-problems with no shared decision variable.
